passage: I'm Lalit, and my younger brother Chaitanya plays a team game every evening after homework. Lately he keeps mentioning a player called Blue Otter, who helps him win the hard levels. "He's so kind, Lalit," Chaitanya said last night, grinning at the screen. I asked whether Blue Otter knew where we live. "No! I just say I'm from India," he said, and he showed me the friend list on the screen. He also told Mummy the names of everyone he plays with. He looks happy. I can't tell how close he really feels to Blue Otter, but I keep an eye on it.

qa.q: What is the name of the player who helps Chaitanya win?
qa.a: The player is called Blue Otter.

qa.q: How does Chaitanya seem to feel about Blue Otter, and what can Lalit not know for sure?
qa.a: He seems happy and close to Blue Otter, but Lalit says he cannot tell how close Chaitanya really feels.

qa.q: What habits could Chaitanya keep up while enjoying his game friend?
qa.a: Keep private details to himself and keep telling Mummy who he plays with, as he does now.

qa.q: What might worry Lalit even though Chaitanya seems careful?
qa.a: That an online friend can still be a stranger, which is why he keeps an eye on it even though Chaitanya shows him the friend list.

grounding: Illustrates a child feeling close to a kind online game player while keeping details private and telling parents who he plays with.
